Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms

Class JdbcSmsCostLedgerRepository

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms.JdbcSmsCostLedgerRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
SmsCostLedgerRepository
@Repository public class JdbcSmsCostLedgerRepository extends Object implements SmsCostLedgerRepository
SmsCostLedgerRepository over the sms_cost_ledger table. It opens no transaction: a reservation runs in the caller's, where it first takes a PostgreSQL transaction-level advisory lock, so that concurrent senders (of this or another instance) check and record their messages one after the other and a cap is never overshot. The check and the insert are one conditional statement, so a refused message leaves no row. A refusal is logged, without the number or the country, so that an exhausted budget can be seen.
